title: Three-Dimensional Vessels-on-a-Chip with hiPSC-Derived Cells
author: Bulut, Vila Cuenca, et al.
materials: Dulbecco's modified Eagle's medium/nutrient mixture F-12
Differentiation of VSMCs from hiPSC‐NCCs takes 12 days:
Steps 31‐34: ∼20 min to thaw cryopreserved hiPSC‐NCCs;
Immunofluorescence staining of hiPSC‐VSMCs takes 2 days:
Step 23: ∼45 min to wash the cells.
Further differentiation of hiPSC‐VSMCs takes 4 days:
The fabrication of PDMS devices takes 2 days:
Immunofluorescence staining of vessels takes 2 days:
Step 7: ∼45 min to wash the lumens.

steps.title: Thaw and culture hiPSC‑VSMCs
steps.instruction: Thaw cryopreserved hiPSC‑VSMCs (day 8 of differentiation) and culture them in VSMC differentiation medium for 4 days until >90 % confluency, preparing them for integration into collagen scaffolds.

steps.title: Thaw and expand hiPSC‑ECs
steps.instruction: Thaw cryopreserved hiPSC‑ECs and expand them in Endothelial Cell Complete Growth Medium (EC‑CGM) for 4 days until >90 % confluency before integration into the lumenized scaffolds.

steps.title: Differentiate hiPSCs to NCCs
steps.instruction: Perform the neural‑crest differentiation of hiPSCs following the timed passage and media‑refresh steps.

substeps.instruction: Steps 1‑8: Passage hiPSCs for maintenance (~20 min).
Steps 9‑13: Passage hiPSCs onto a Matrigel‑coated plate for neural‑crest differentiation (~20 min).
Step 15: Refresh the cells every 2 days (~15 min each refresh).
Steps 16‑17: Detach the centers of colonies and refresh each well (~15 min).

steps.title: Expand and cryopreserve hiPSC‑NCCs
steps.instruction: Expand hiPSC‑NCCs to passage 3 and cryopreserve aliquots for later use.

substeps.instruction: Steps 19‑25: Passage hiPSC‑NCCs for expansion (~20 min).
Steps 27‑30: Cryopreserve hiPSC‑NCCs (~30 min).

steps.title: Differentiate NCCs to VSMCs
steps.instruction: Convert hiPSC‑NCCs into vascular smooth muscle cells (VSMCs) and generate a cryopreserved stock.

substeps.instruction: Steps 31‑34: Thaw cryopreserved hiPSC‑NCCs (~20 min).
Steps 36‑37: Change the medium every 2 days (~15 min each change).
Steps 38‑44: Passage cells (~20 min).
Steps 45 and 47: Refresh the cells (~15 min).
Steps 48‑51: Cryopreserve hiPSC‑VSMCs (~30 min).

steps.title: Flow cytometry analysis of NCCs
steps.instruction: Stain hiPSC‑NCCs for surface and intracellular markers and acquire data by flow cytometry.

substeps.instruction: Steps 1‑11: Perform surface staining followed by intracellular staining of hiPSC‑NCCs (~2.5 h).
Step 12: Run the stained samples on the flow cytometer (~30 min).

steps.title: Immunofluorescence of hiPSC‑VSMCs
steps.instruction: Fix, stain, and image hiPSC‑VSMCs using primary and secondary antibodies.

substeps.instruction: Steps 13‑15: Dissociate and seed hiPSC‑VSMCs, then culture for 24 h (~20 min active work).
Steps 16‑19: Fix, wash, permeabilize, and block the cells (~1.5 h).
Step 20: Dilute primary antibodies and add to wells (~15 min).
Steps 21‑22: Wash and add diluted secondary antibodies (~45 min).
Step 23: Final wash (~45 min).

steps.title: Further differentiate hiPSC‑VSMCs
steps.instruction: Thaw and seed cryopreserved VSMCs, then refresh on day 10.

substeps.instruction: Steps 1‑5: Thaw cryopreserved VSMCs and seed into wells (~20 min).
Step 6: Refresh the cultures on day 10 (~15 min).

steps.title: Expand hiPSC‑ECs
steps.instruction: Thaw and seed cryopreserved ECs, then change medium on day 3.

substeps.instruction: Steps 7‑11: Thaw cryopreserved ECs and seed into wells (~20 min).
Step 12: Change the medium on day 3 (~15 min).

steps.title: Fabricate PDMS microdevices
steps.instruction: Prepare, cure, cut, assemble, functionalize, and sterilize PDMS devices for the vessel‑on‑chip platform.

substeps.instruction: Steps 1‑3: Prepare PDMS mixture and cure overnight (~20 min active work).
Step 4: Coat cover glasses with PDMS and cure overnight (~20 min).
Steps 5‑8: Cut and assemble PDMS devices (~30 min).
Step 9: Functionalize PDMS surface with PDA incubation (1 h) and total functionalization time ~1.5 h.
Step 10: Perform UV + ozone sterilization (~1 h).

steps.title: Pattern collagen I lumen scaffolds
steps.instruction: Create collagen‑filled lumens inside the PDMS devices and incubate for polymerization and equilibration.

substeps.instruction: Step 12: Insert pipet tips into inlet and outlet ports (~5 min).
Steps 13‑14: Prepare the collagen gel (~5 min).
Step 15: Pattern the lumens and allow collagen polymerization for 30 min (~5 min + 30 min).
Step 16: Add medium onto polymerized collagen gel and incubate overnight (~5 min + overnight).

steps.title: Seed cells into collagen lumens
steps.instruction: Introduce VSMCs and ECs into the collagen lumens, rotate devices for uniform seeding, and refresh daily.

substeps.instruction: Steps 17‑20: Replace pipet tips with medium reservoirs (~10 min).
Steps 21‑26: Dissociate hiPSC‑VSMCs, count, seed into lumens, then rotate devices for 1 h (~30 min active + 1 h rotation).
Step 27: Add medium into the lumens (~5 min).
Steps 28‑36: Dissociate hiPSC‑ECs, count, seed into lumens, then rotate devices for 5 h (~30 min active + 5 h rotation).
Steps 37‑38: Refresh the lumens every day (~10 min).

steps.title: Immunofluorescence staining of vessels
steps.instruction: Fix, block, and stain the assembled vessels with primary and secondary antibodies, including incubation steps.

substeps.instruction: Steps 1‑3: Fix, permeabilize, and block the vessels (~1.5 h).
Step 4: Dilute primary antibodies and add to lumens (~15 min).
Steps 5‑6: Wash, add secondary antibodies, and incubate for 2 h (~45 min + 2 h incubation).
Step 7: Final wash (~45 min).
